scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p renderer/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:build: npm run renderer:build && npm run build -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build -w @herdr-bot/desktop && npm run start -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @herdr-bot/desktop && HERDR_BOT_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 HERDR_BOT_DEV=1 npm run start -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --project desktop
